1. Analisis Kebudayaan & Sejarah

Latar Belakang Sejarah:

Created by Prince Cakrabuana in the 16th century, strongly influenced by Chinese traders who entered the port of Cirebon.

Philosophy & Cultural Meaning:

Rain clouds symbolize a leadership that cools and gives life (rain) without discrimination.

Event Etiquette & Usage:

Suitable for formal leadership events, diplomatic meetings, and evening wedding receptions.

100% Cotton Primissima (Density 130/70). Uses natural Daun Nila dye (Indigofera tinctoria).

Knowledge Base & Research

Batik & Sustainable Fashion Wiki

Explore scientific articles, a comparison of natural vs synthetic dyes, and a map of Indonesian batik varieties.

🧪

Natural Dyes vs Synthetic

Natural batik dyes such as Indigofera tinctoria (blue), secang wood (red), and tingi bark (brown) are free of azo carcinogenic substances. Natural dye waste is easily biodegradable.

🧬

Cellulose Fiber Degradation

Primissima cotton is pure cellulose. Washing with lerak soap (natural saponin) keeps the pH neutral (pH 6-7), preventing degradation of the fiber’s hydrogen bonds.

🔥

Thermal Resistance of Wax

Wax (beeswax & gondorukem) melts at 60°C - 70°C. Controlling the wax-removal temperature (melorot) requires scientific precision so the dye does not fade.
